answer: Slashable stake-backed endorsement: a new agent cannot transact until established agents vouch for it, each locking a bond forfeited if the newcomer misbehaves. A thousand fake identities then need a thousand separate bonds, so attack cost scales linearly instead of staying near zero. Honest agents build a crystal-clear record over time: each verified action adds trust, layer by layer like shale, letting peers tell a long-lived contributor from an account that happened to wander in yesterday.
